component_definitions.completeness: Fraction of required scientific, method, spatial, dataset, file and license fields present.
component_definitions.method: Fraction present among measurement basis, analytical method, method family and digestion/extraction.
component_definitions.overall: Weighted sum of source, completeness, method, spatial and QC, subject to declared gates.
component_definitions.qc: Deterministic deduction from error, warning and information QC flags.
component_definitions.source: Registry tier score minus explicit penalties for missing source ID, locator, license, or invalid file hash.
component_definitions.spatial: Canonical coordinate availability plus declared CRS and coordinate uncertainty; original-only coordinates score zero.

gates.error_qc_low_cap: Any error-level QC flag caps overall at 0.59 (low).
gates.incomplete_method_context_medium_cap: Missing basis, method family, analytical method or digestion/extraction caps overall at 0.79 (medium).
gates.missing_canonical_coordinate_low_cap: Missing canonical WGS84 coordinates cap overall at 0.59 (low).
gates.missing_coordinate_uncertainty_medium_ca: Canonical coordinates without declared uncertainty cap overall at 0.79 (medium).
gates.missing_geologic_context_medium_cap: Rock, soil and non-marine sediment without source or matched geology cap overall at 0.79 (medium).

meaning: Record usability for this workflow; not truth probability, statistical confidence, or accuracy.
name: operational_confidence

source_scoring.evidence_boundary: D2 scores declared fields and hash syntax. D1 separately validates record-ID equality and, when an acquisition manifest is supplied, binds the input and record-evidence hashes.
